inspiration: repipe round 3 need get-pc-helper-loses; the input-side sibling of kuna_rustabi's callee-body probe (the call-OUTPUT seam) and of calleedeadarg's entry-liveness probe (the input-TRIAL seam)
hypothesis_status: upheld as filed and as measured by the captain at T_REFUTE: an ordinary caller-clobbering ABI model applied to a register-preserving helper. Two refinements the record did not have. (1) Downgrading the effect is only half the fix: guardCalls's output-active branch re-promotes the range to killedbycall whenever it characterizes as return storage, which on i386 EDX does (the EAX:EDX join pentry), so the output arm has to be skipped for the same range. (2) The general form the captain scoped -- 'trust a fully decoded, non-recursive, call-free callee' -- is NOT sound on its own: it regressed 24 stage assertions across 7 testcases, every one a fixture whose callee is a deliberate one-byte `ret` placeholder. Absence of a write needed a positive counterpart (the callee must write a callee-saved register).

gates.make rust-test: green (KUNA_DECOMP_TEST unset; that harness var alone reddens verify_w10_proto_unlock)

probe_flip.before: sub_8049f55(); return __lxstat(3,path,v1);  with `unsigned int v1; // edx` never assigned

promoted_probe.why: the acceptance target is a dataset binary and CI has no dataset; the fixture carries the witness's bytes verbatim with the PLT call retargeted in-image

sweep.arm_a: 128 decbench ELFs (x86-64 PIE and ARM, O0 and O2), 15,987 functions, decompile-all both arms: 0 functions changed
sweep.arm_b: 47 x86-32 crackme images (PE32 and ELF i386), 7,064 functions: 15 functions changed, 0 that start reading a never-assigned local
sweep.arm_b_detail: 9 functions lose a never-assigned local outright; 4 are __thiscall constructors whose ECX `this` is recovered as a real parameter instead of an unassigned `v1 // ecx`; 1 (SCORPiON sub_40cb88) re-sources the return from the real producer instead of from `pop edi; pop esi; leave; ret`, which is the second filed instance's shape; 1 (ErnoCube sub_402b90) renders an 8-byte join return where a 4-byte pointer read better, the same over-recovery calloverlap documents

decisions: The downgrade is applied to the effect guardCalls reads from the prototype AND the output-active arm is skipped for the same range. Downgrading alone is inert on the witness: characterize_as_output(EDX,4) is non-empty on i386 (the EAX:EDX join pentry), so the branch promotes the range straight back to killedbycall.

Absence of a recorded write is not sufficient evidence. A complete walk over a one-byte `ret` records nothing and so claims that EVERY register survives the call, which deletes the return value of every stub, thunk and placeholder in the image; ghdec-calloverlap's callee is documented as exactly that byte. The callee must ALSO have written a register the model marks <unaffected>, other than the stack pointer (every RET writes it). That is the signature of the hand-rolled helper the rule exists for and it is a positive finding rather than an absence -- the same shape calleedeadarg's header argues for on the input-trial seam.

No new pass and no new Action: the decision is taken at the one seam that consumes the effect (Heritage::guard_calls), and the evidence is the existing kuna_rustabi callee-body walk sharing the existing per-image cache, so a body is decoded at most once per run whichever rule asks.
